study_identification_part.si_4_title: Regional, circuit and network heterogeneity of brain abnormalities in psychiatric disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: 14 datasets with 25 scan sites were used for the normative modeling analysis, plus HCP-YA for FC mapping. Specifically: ABIDE-I (8 sites: CALTECH, CMU, LEUVEN_1, MAX-MUN, NYU, PITT, SBL, USM); ABIDE-II (2 sites: BNI, IU); ASRB (4 sites: BRIS, MELB, PERT, SYDN); FEMS (First Episode Mania Study, single-site); MON (Monash Cohort, single-site, HC only); IMpACT-NL (International Multicentre persistent ADHD CollaboraTion); KANMDD (Kansas Musical Depression Study from OpenNeuro, single-site); MITASD (MIT Autism Study from OpenNeuro, single-site); OCDPG (Obsessive-Compulsive and Problematic Gambling study, single-site); RUSMDD (Russia fMRI Depression Study from OpenNeuro, single-site); SPAINOCD (single-site); TOP15 (Thematically Organized Psychosis, single-site); WASHASD (University of Washington ASD Study from OpenNeuro, single-site); YoDA (single-site); HCP-YA (150 unrelated HCs from S900 release for FC mapping).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We examined data for 1,465 HCs (54.47% male) and 1,294 cases, taken from 14 different studies and 25 different scan sites." ... "The functional circuitry of deviant regions was mapped using an independent cohort of 150 resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) scans (71 males, age 21-35 years) from the S900 release of the Human Connectome Project (HCP)."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: 90% of HCs from sites with >=30 HCs were allocated to HCtrain; remaining 10% of HCs plus all cases formed the test set (HCtest + clinical groups). For sites with <30 HCs, all HC data went into training. HCP-YA was used solely for mapping the functional circuitry of extreme deviations via seed-based FC analysis, independent of the normative model.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The training data for the normative model (HCtrain) were created by randomly selecting 90% of HC individuals from each site, provided that the site included data for >=30 HCs. For sites with smaller HC samples, all HC data were included in the training set. The test data (HCtest)...comprised the 10% of HCs from sites with >=30 HCs and all case scans."

model-1.model-name: Hierarchical Bayesian Regression (HBR) normative model for regional GMV

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was built using HBR fitted separately in each of 1,032 brain regions. HCtrain comprised 1,196 HCs (55.02% male). HCtest comprised 269 HCs (52.04% male) as a held-out normative benchmark. Total HC = 1,465 (54.47% male). Additionally, 150 unrelated HCs from HCP were used for FC mapping but were not part of the normative model.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "We examined data for 1,465 HCs (54.47% male) and 1,294 cases, taken from 14 different studies and 25 different scan sites." ... "We then trained a normative model based on hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR), fitted separately in each region, in a training set comprising 1,196 HCs (55.02% male; Fig. 2a; HCtrain)" ... "The remaining 269 controls (52.04% male; age range 18-62 years) were held out as a test set (HCtest)"
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Segal2023.pdf.md: Results / Sample characteristics, L47; Results / Normative modeling, L51

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall age range reported as 18-64 years (exclusion criteria: below 18 or above 64). HCtrain spanned the age range of cases, enabling predictions for people aged 18-64 years. HCtest age range was 18-62 years. Per-site medians, SDs, and ranges are provided in Supplementary Table 1 but no aggregate mean/SD is reported for the full HC sample. Age range of 18-64 is inferred from exclusion criteria (participants excluded if below 18 or above 64) and Supplementary Table 1 showing sites with max age of 64 (e.g., ABIDE-II BNI: 18-64, ASRB-BRIS: 18-63, TOP15: 18-64 for patients).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "we excluded participants if they were below 18 years or above 64 years of age (N=346)" ... "HCtrain spanned the age range of cases, enabling predictions for people aged between 18 and 64 years" ... "The remaining 269 controls (52.04% male; age range 18-62 years) were held out as a test set (HCtest)"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall HC: 1,465 with 54.47% male. 1465 * 0.5447 = 797.8 ~ 798 male, 667 female (45.53%). HCtrain: 1,196 with 55.02% male. 1196 * 0.5502 = 658.0 male, 538 female (44.98%). HCtest: 269 with 52.04% male. The paper explicitly states HCtest = 269 individuals with 140 male, yielding 129 female. Cross-check: 658 + 140 = 798 male total, 538 + 129 = 667 female total, consistent with overall figures.
